[Meeting] Hillsborough Community Collge Business Industry Leadership Team_NSF_Cloud Computing initiative
Hillsborough Community Collge Business Industry Leadership Team_NSF_Cloud Computing initiative

The new Cloud Computing program at Hillsborough Community College, Tampa Florida.

HCC has received a grant from a National Science Foundation, which is providing the funding for development of a new associate of science degree plan and a college certificate program in cloud computing for the college. To support the new programs, HCC is launching a Business and Industry Leadership Team (BILT) model with business and industry experts to align the new curriculum to industry needs and ensure students are prepared for careers in cloud computing.
